title: Goonje saare aalam me
body:
Ya husain ya husain ya husain..(4)
<<MINI>>
Goonje saare aalam me..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
allah kare bus hi kalaam
salaam salaam
salaaam munjhe sabir husain maula salaam..(2)
1. Maula haider ja hubdaro
<<DIVIDER>>
maula husain ja matamdaro
sain zainab ja pursa daro
subha shaam hado hi naaro
<<MINI>>
gunje saare aalam me...
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Majlis, matam, girya zaari
alam, sabeelu taziyadari
singa rey maula ji sawari
sog manaye duniya saari
<<MINI>>
gunje saare aalam me...
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ghum sa dil abaad ka nokar
karbobala khe yaad ka nokar
har kam in kha baad ka nokar
teher yahi faryaad ka nokar
<<MINI>>
gunje saare aalam me...
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Je siyahe seene me dum
kara nowa shabbira jo matam
aahe dua lehrae hardam
har ghara de abbas jo parcham
<<MINI>>
gunje saare aalam me...
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Yasrab thi veeran chave tho
karbala jo maidan chave tho
shaamwaro zindaan chave tho
ratt roi qur'an chave tho
<<MINI>>
gunje saare aalam me...
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Naize jo haswaar na gusre
qaide pardadaar na gusre
shaam wali bazaar na gusre
fasiqa ji darbaar na gusre
<<MINI>>
gunje saare aalam me...
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jawwad o irfan dua aa
ghot bitaiya ji mansha aa
nooraniya jiwiya nida aa
sehwaniya jiwiya sadaa
<<MINI>>
gunje saare aalam me...
<<DIVIDER>>
